# Home Loans by Megan

> Megan Mello is a Sr. Loan Officer with RESCOM Mortgage Lending, Inc., serving San Diego and all of California, with 22+ years of experience in mortgage brokerage, underwriting, processing, and origination. She specializes in loans other lenders turned down: self-employed borrowers, non-traditional income, and complex files. She also offers DSCR loans for rental investors in most states.

Megan Mello: NMLS #632565, DRE #02098325. RESCOM Mortgage Lending, Inc.: NMLS #226471, DRE #01854569, 940 Calle Amanecer, Suite D, San Clemente, CA 92673. Contact: call or text 760-672-5773, or email megan@rescomfs.com.

Loan programs: purchase loans, HELOCs, cash-out and rate-and-term refinances, non-QM bank statement and P&L loans, and reverse mortgages (California properties); DSCR loans for rental properties up to 10 units, including properties held in an LLC (most states).
